def config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Value for `key` in a `name=value` per-line config text, or "" if absent.

    Each line is split at its first "=". The name and value are stripped of
    surrounding whitespace. Lines without "=" are ignored. If the key appears
    more than once, the first occurrence wins.
    """
    ex config_value(text="a=1\nb=2", key="b") == "2"
    ex config_value(text="a=1\nb=2", key="c") == ""
    ex config_value(text="a = 1\n# note\nb = x=y", key="b") == "x=y"
    ex config_value(text="a=1\na=2", key="a") == "1"
    ex config_value(text="", key="a") == ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        name, sep, val = raw.partition("=")
        if sep == "":
            continue
        if name.strip() == key:
            return val.strip()
    return ""
